scope: Only component IDs listed in the fixed input plan are scored. References/gold are scorer-only and never added to inference inputs.
scoring: Component references are concatenated in plan order; canonical gold mention Counters are added across components. Raw and clean hits are capped substring counts; CER is Levenshtein on normalized joined reference and text.
same_session_firstpass: When result.entity_audio_repair.evaluation_backend.primary_finish_text exists, raw_vs_firstpass compares same-session final raw to first-pass ASR and is the entity-module raw-level signal. clean_vs_firstpass compares final clean to first-pass ASR and includes the full Web refinement pipeline. Paired deltas show whether final-raw cross-arm hit/error differences were already present in primary_finish_text. Missing fields remain null. HTTP calls are request counts; wall seconds are completed request-handler time, not GPU compute.

raw_vs_firstpass.interpretation: Same-session final raw vs primary_finish_text; raw-level entity-module signal.

clean_vs_firstpass.interpretation: Same-session final clean vs primary_finish_text; full Web pipeline including refinement.

old.timing_backend_note: primary/replay HTTP calls count backend requests. primary/replay wall seconds measure completed request-handler time, not GPU compute time. active_http_requests is the snapshot value.
